1: // Neon Runner – minimal endless runner
2: // Canvas with id "game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5: if (!canvas) throw new Error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
6: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7: 
8: // Resize canvas to fill its container
9: function resize() {
10:   const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
11:   canvas.width = rect.width;
12:   canvas.height = rect.height;
13: }
14: window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
15: resize();
16: 
17: // Player (neon square)
18: const player = {
19:   x: 50, // constant horizontal position
20:   y: 0,
21:   size: 20,
22:   vy: 0,
23:   color: '#0ff',
24:   onGround: false,
25: };
26: const GRAVITY = 0.6;
27: const JUMP = -12;
28: 
29: // World segments scrolling leftward
30: let segments = [];
31: const SEG_LEN = 100; // width of each segment
32: let nextSegX = canvas.width; // x coordinate where next segment starts
33: let speed = 3; // scrolling speed
34: let score = 0;
35: let highScore = Number(localStorage.getItem('highScore')) || 0;
36: let gameOver = false;
37: 
38: function spawnSegment() {
39:   const hasGround = Math.random() > 0.2; // 80% ground
40:   const hasSpike = hasGround && Math.random() < 0.2; // occasional spikes
41:   segments.push({ x: nextSegX, width: SEG_LEN, hasGround, hasSpike });
42:   nextSegX += SEG_LEN;
43: }
44: 
45: // Fill initial segments
46: while (nextSegX < canvas.width * 2) spawnSegment();
47: 
48: // Input – tap/click or spacebar to jump
49: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') jump(); });
50: window.addEventListener('pointerdown', jump);
51: function jump() { if (player.onGround) { player.vy = JUMP; player.onGround = false; } }
52: 
53: function endGame() { gameOver = true; }
54: 
55: function update() {
56:   if (gameOver) return;
57: 
58:   // Player physics
59:   player.vy += GRAVITY;
60:   player.y += player.vy;
61: 
62:   const groundY = canvas.height - 30;
63:   const seg = segments.find(s => player.x >= s.x && player.x < s.x + s.width);
64:   const onGroundSegment = seg && seg.hasGround;
65:   const onSpike = seg && seg.hasSpike && player.x > seg.x && player.x < seg.x + seg.width && player.y + player.size > groundY - 20;
66: 
67:   if (onSpike) endGame();
68: 
69:   // Landing logic
70:   if (player.y + player.size >= groundY) {
71:     if (onGroundSegment) {
72:       player.y = groundY - player.size;
73:       player.vy = 0;
74:       player.onGround = true;
75:     } else {
76:       endGame(); // fell into gap
77:     }
78:   }
79: 
80:   // Scroll world
81:   for (let i = segments.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
82:     segments[i].x -= speed;
83:     if (segments[i].x + segments[i].width < 0) segments.splice(i, 1);
84:   }
85:   if (nextSegX - speed < canvas.width * 2) spawnSegment();
86:   nextSegX -= speed;
87: 
88:   // Score based on distance travelled
89:   score = Math.floor((canvas.width - player.x + speed * (segments.length * SEG_LEN)) / 10);
90:   if (score > highScore) {
91:     highScore = score;
92:     localStorage.setItem('highScore', highScore);
93:   }
94: }
95: 
96: function draw() {
97:   // Clear background
98:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
99:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
100: 
101:   // Ground and spikes
102:   const groundY = canvas.height - 30;
103:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
104:   for (const s of segments) {
105:     if (s.hasGround) {
106:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, groundY, s.width, 30);
107:       if (s.hasSpike) {
108:         ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
109:         ctx.beginPath();
110:         ctx.moveTo(s.x + s.width / 2 - 5, groundY);
111:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.width / 2 + 5, groundY);
112:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.width / 2, groundY - 20);
113:         ctx.closePath();
114:         ctx.fill();
115:         ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
116:       }
117:     }
118:   }
119: 
120:   // Player
121:   ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
122:   ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size);
123: 
124:   // UI
125:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
126:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
127:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
128:   ctx.fillText(`High: ${highScore}`, 10, 40);
129: 
130:   if (gameOver) {
131:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
132:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
133:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
134:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
135:     ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
136:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
137:   }
138: }
139: 
140: function loop() { update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
141: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
